Mina: Tiny challenge for tonight's swap thread: one song under 4:00 + one single-episode TV ep or short film under 30min. No novels. I'll go first.
Mina: Song — 'Angel Olsen - Shut Up Kiss Me' (3:36). Short — 'La Jetee' is longer in spirit but pick a short experimental clip (15min) works.
Omar: Love that energy. My pick:
Omar: Song — 'LCD Soundsystem - All My Friends' (3:55 edit). Short — 'Night Of The Living Dreadlocks' (found-footage short, 12min) ideal for late-night.
Tess: Going cozy:
Tess: Song — 'Sufjan Stevens - Mystery of Love' (3:37). Short — 'Stutterer' (short, ~13min) beautiful little film.
Rene: Guilty-pleasure time:
Rene: Song — 'Robyn - Dancing On My Own' (4:00 exact but still counts?) ; Short — 'Nathan For You' clip (S1 mini-ep segment, ~10min) sorry not sorry.
Kai: Quick logistics: office projector's scheduled Fri 3pm for the micro-viewing. Whoever brings snacks gets first pick of the playlist order. :popcorn:
Mina: Also, archive-bot will sweep unlabeled physical DVDs from lounge Saturday 9am. Label anything you want kept as "swap".
archive-bot: Reminder: Label items with "swap" by Fri 8pm or items will be moved to free-shelf.
Omar: Poll: react :one: if you want evening slot (6pm), :two: for after-work coffee (4:30), :three: for weekend. I'll tally in 2 hours.
Tess: Tiny playlist idea: I'll compile everyone's songs into a 10-track "microset" and add crossfades. Want collaborative?
Rene: Yes please. Also pro tip: if you want short-film mirrors, upload to /team/media/shorts/ and tag with runtime.
Mina: Voting update: :one: 3 :two: 2 :three: 1 evening wins. See you all tonight for low-fi listening/viewing. Bring a 60-sec intro if you feel like it.
Kai: I'll bring HDMI + speaker. Snacks provided by Tess (legend).
Omar: Sharing placeholder playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/placeholderMiniMix
Tess: Tiny shoutout to Mina for starting this  excellent mini-curation idea. :clap:
